headline: Future Openings
description: There are currently no open positions. However, the Hur Lab periodically welcomes motivated postdoctoral fellows, graduate students, and visiting scholars interested in bioinformatics, AI/ML, and multi-omics systems biology. Please check back or reach out to express your interest for future opportunities.

positionTypes.title: Post-doctoral Fellow
requirements: Bioinformatics, AI/ML, or related computational field

positionTypes.title: Graduate Student
requirements: Ph.D. programs in Computer Science, Biomedical Sciences, or Biomedical Engineering
Interest in computational biology or data science
Background in biology, computer science, or related field
Competitive stipend and tuition support available

positionTypes.title: Visiting Scholar
requirements: International researchers welcome for collaborative visits
Flexible duration from 6 months to 3 years
Access to computational resources and mentoring

researchAreas: Multi-omics analysis of diabetic neuropathy and metabolic syndrome
Ontology and AI-based biomedical data integration (OLAS, MILAM, LAM-AI)
Development of computational tools for biological data visualization and enrichment analysis
